bullets: • Qualify numerator and denominator independently for each metric.
• Round percentages to nearest integer; always suffix with '%'.
• Display '—' when column lacks qualifying data; '0%' when zero records.
• Sort descending by metric value; break ties ascending sprint number.
• State one testable outcome per column or conditional display state.
• Verify metric calculation logic without referencing data retrieval implementation.
• Distinguish between "no data" (—) and "zero qualifying records" (0%).
• Define exact fallback message when entire dataset is empty or absent.

• CRITICAL: Verdict fields use 'approve'/'reject' — never 'pass'/'fail'. ac_check_verdict and code_review_verdict both use 'approve' for success. AC that references 'pass' or 'fail' for these fields will produce 0% pass rates.
